data.summary: The independent validation report for CR-001 (CR-001 Retail PD Scorecard) has been completed, resulting in an overall rating of Not fit for use. Key findings include significant issues with input stability, specifically with the following metrics: Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `status.of.existing.checking.account` (red), Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `credit.history` (red), Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `purpose` (red), and Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `savings.account.and.bonds` (red). Additionally, Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `present.employment.since` received an amber status, while the metric for `sex` achieved a pass status. The report also highlights several findings, including hardcoded decision thresholds and the use of every column in the model.
